meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品一键套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同文档或演示统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need consistent colors and fonts across documents and presentations

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以为幻灯片、文档等作品应用预设或自定义主题，包括配色和字体。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 美化幻灯片或文档，并选择或创建主题时触发。

say.text: 给这个幻灯片应用“海洋深处”主题。
say.note: Claude 会应用该主题的配色和字体。

say.text: 帮我创建一个以“夏日海滩”为主题的新样式。
say.note: Claude 会生成新主题并让你确认。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can apply preset or custom themes (colors and fonts) to artifacts like slides, docs, and HTML pages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to style an artifact and select or create a theme.

say_en.text: Apply the 'Ocean Depths' theme to this slide deck.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the theme's colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Create a custom theme called 'Summer Beach'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a new theme for review.
